h2: NOT JUST MODELS. SYSTEMS THAT WORK.
Engineering that moves ideas into systems.
Tools for building and shipping AI.
p: AI / ML ENGINEER  ·  COMPUTER VISION  ·  RESEARCH

I’m a Computer Science & Engineering student specialising in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning. I build applied AI across computer vision, audio intelligence and language models — taking ideas from experiments to useful, deployed products.

I build applied AI systems across computer vision, audio intelligence and efficient language models — taking ideas from experiments to usable, deployed products. My work combines model development with the engineering needed to ship real applications.

I’m a Computer Science & Engineering student specialising in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning at Ramrao Adik Institute of Technology, D. Y. Patil University. I’m focused on building practical AI products and strengthening the research behind them.

My work spans computer vision, audio AI and language models, alongside the systems around them: data preparation, model evaluation, inference APIs, web interfaces and deployment. I care about measurable performance, reproducibility and making models useful beyond a notebook.
Research interests include computer vision, image processing, deep learning, vision transformers, multimodal AI, NLP, efficient machine learning and knowledge distillation.
Ramrao Adik Institute of Technology · D. Y. Patil University
Computer Vision · Deep Learning · Applied AI
Semester VII examinations completed; results pending
A few principles that guide how I learn, build and collaborate.
Clarify the goal, constraints and evidence before choosing a model.
Use experiments and measurable evaluation instead of relying on assumptions.
Think beyond the model: data, APIs, interfaces, deployment and reliability matter.
Document decisions, explain trade-offs and use feedback to improve the result.
Started B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering, specialising in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, at Ramrao Adik Institute of Technology, D. Y. Patil University.
Developed hands-on machine-learning projects across computer vision, voice recognition, predictive modelling and full-stack AI applications.
Participated in the Summer University programme focused on Information Technology & AI, including HackAtom 2026.
Developing the SLM–DistilBERT candidate-selection study around efficient language models, knowledge distillation and evaluation. Manuscript in preparation.
Targeting completion of B.Tech CSE (AI & ML) and preparing for postgraduate study in Artificial Intelligence or a closely related technical field.

The study explores whether a smaller language model can reduce expensive candidate-selection or tool-use overhead while preserving downstream decision quality. Two strategies are being evaluated: direct replacement and hybrid shortlisting. The academic manuscript is in preparation.
Status: ongoing research · manuscript in preparation · no publication claimed

A selection of applied projects across vision, audio, efficient NLP, geospatial analytics and product engineering. Metrics are labelled as reported where appropriate.

Real-time American Sign Language gesture recognition. A webcam feed passes through MediaPipe hand-landmark detection into a trained TensorFlow/Keras classifier, with recognised gestures displayed as text.
29 gesture classes · classification prototype, not full sign-language translation
MediaPipe · TensorFlow · Keras · OpenCV · React · FastAPI
Spoken-digit recognition. Record or upload audio and a neural network predicts the digit with a confidence score, served by a FastAPI backend behind a React frontend.
TensorFlow · FastAPI · React · Firebase · Docker · Hugging Face

A candidate-selection study testing whether a compact language model can replace or pre-filter an expensive selection step. Compares full replacement with hybrid shortlisting before downstream evaluation.
Reported: 96.3% Recall@20 · 96% decision parity · 33.3% fewer tool calls vs. a 90-call baseline
DistilBERT · Small language models · Knowledge distillation · Evaluation

Interactive nuclear-infrastructure analytics and forecasting. Integrates global facility data, weighted statistical modelling, logistic S-curve deployment projections and coastal-distance calculations. Main developer of the STATS dashboard as part of a team.
Python · React · Pandas · Shapely · Geospatial analysis · S-curve forecasting
An OpenAI API-powered website chatbot with conversation history, a Cloudflare Worker proxy, CORS handling and rate limiting to protect the backend.
